F27 FAIL for 2024-09-30 (value 2.6568); coverage unchanged and right. Reviewer re-ran scratch/fund_runs/0001825265/f27_test.py on t8yf and checked every typed input against the cached filings: 9M 2024 total investment income 102,320, other fee income 3,096, expenses 44,708, NII 57,612, net accretion 6,163 (0000950170-24-125154); FY 2024 136,266 / 3,202 / 60,662 / 75,604 / 8,531 (0000950170-25-045559); FY 2025 169,640 / 321 / 69,511 / 100,129 / 10,049 (0001193125-26-126676). Outputs reproduce: 14.61 / 14.35 / 13.72 pct of average fair value after accretion and fees, period-average published coupon 12.80 / 12.57 / 11.35, unexplained 13.1M / 13.1M / 23.2M a year; the leverage model gives 12.1 pct of net assets against 15.1. insufficient_evidence is the right class and the arithmetic holds. Rejected on two points of reasoning that a reader of the owner proposal would rely on. (1) The money-fund hypothesis is argued on the wrong basis: the gap is measured in dollars against a run-rate of loan rows only, so any money-fund income inside printed 'Interest income' (the statement of operations shows no other line for it) adds to the gap whatever its yield. The schedules print the balances and yields (60.8M at 4.82 pct at 2024-09-30; 87.8M at 4.39 pct at 2024-12-31; 41.0M at 3.68 pct at 2025-12-31), so about 2.5M to 3.5M a year of the gap can be estimated from the cache; it does not close the gap but must be measured, not dismissed. (2) missing_evidence item 3 is overstated: a loan repaid inside a period is printed with its coupon on the prior quarter-end schedule and is already in the period-average run-rate; what is not printed is the repayment date (and loans both made and repaid inside one quarter). Items 1 and 2 are truly not in the cache: no average invested balance is printed, and the 10-K MD&A says 'Other fee income' is late-closer fees from investors, with prepayment, consent and forbearance fees recognised as income but never broken out. Fix: quantify the money-fund income, restate item 3, and drop 'the filings do not print' from the F27 proposal for the part they do print.

Consequences: (a) the proposed fix, suppressing 'noninterestexpense' only, would still let RepurchaseAgreementsInterestExpenseAmount match 'interestexpense', so 2024+ quarters could fall to 0 instead of the printed line; the next action must name InterestAndDebtExpense as the target and be checked in all 17 quarters. Needs a branch that would catch the repurchase-interest substitution (for example published interest expense below the printed credit facility interest, or below 1 pct of total liabilities).
